name: 共有範囲・所有者・属性ごとの内訳を持つ表示管理パネル
prompt:
Recreate the complete saved-view management panel shown in the primary original Linear crop. Match the source crop aspect ratio 494:399 (about 1.24:1), three vertically stacked white cards, rounded corners, light borders, spacing, inset alignment and compact type. The original source controls all geometry, icon art, owner identity, colors and counts; use the Japanese mock only for localized wording.

The first card has a small gray outline thumbs-up icon, title 「優先度の高い作業」, outline star and three-dot menu aligned on the right, then the smaller gray subtitle 「優先度を「高」にした課題」 beneath the title. Keep the title and subtitle compact and left aligned as in the source.

The second card has two rows. First row: label 「公開範囲」, original gray building icon, value 「共有領域」 representing the source Workspace visibility. Second row: label 「所有者」, the original small purple circle with white AM initials and the exact source email 「alexsmith.mobbin@gmail.com」. Do not substitute the Japanese mock’s mint avatar or 山田 花子 placeholder.

The third card has three rounded tabs 「担当者」 selected with a light gray fill, then 「分類」 and 「案件」 unselected. Below, show exactly two rows: the original gray unassigned-person icon, 「担当者なし」 and right-aligned count 「12」; then the original purple AM avatar, exact email 「alexsmith.mobbin@gmail.com」 and right-aligned count 「2」.

Preserve the original source’s horizontal insets, baselines, row spacing, icon sizes, muted gray labels and restrained dark text. Use a white background and subtle neutral card borders. Do not add data, change identity or counts, omit controls, or include page context.
reviewNotes: Candidate v001 visually compared side-by-side with the original 2x crop. Dimensions 1396x1127 (1.2387:1) against source 494x399 (1.2381:1); SHA-256 9a76a61bcd67affd62c6b6074eece1240f6651dd1e8903b89799b0e500257d79. The three-card geometry, spacing and controls match the source. Japanese title and labels are legible; the source AM avatar, exact owner email and counts 12/2 are preserved. Status: reviewed.
